title: Harbor Rush Classic
desc: The original Harbor Rush, rebuilt entirely in Lazer Studio on the Rush engine: unload ships, juggle trucks, clear customs and grow one pier into a shipping empire.

stations.name: Container crane
stations.desc: Unloads the docked cargo ship one container at a time. Move them to the yard before they sit too long.

stations.name: Customs office
stations.desc: Runs an inspection round, then clears several containers. Inspectors leave if you keep them waiting.

stations.name: Fuel pipeline
stations.desc: Fills a row of tank containers from the tanker line.

stations.name: Reefer crane
stations.desc: Unloads refrigerated fruit. Reefers spoil fast once they are off the ship.

stations.name: Car ramp
stations.desc: Drives new cars off the car carrier. Park them in the yard before they block the ramp.

stations.name: Trawler berth
stations.desc: Hauls fish crates off the trawler. Fish goes bad quickly in the sun.

stations.name: Ice machine
stations.desc: Makes a batch of crushed ice for several loads. It melts if you leave it.

stations.name: Crab boat berth
stations.desc: Lands crab pots from the crab boat.

stations.name: Oyster tanks
stations.desc: Purges a batch of oysters and packs them into tubs.

stations.name: Grain silo
stations.desc: Fills grain hopper containers from the silo.

stations.name: Ore conveyor
stations.desc: Unloads iron ore from the bulk carrier. Ore piles block the conveyor if left.

stations.name: Luggage gangway
stations.desc: Sends passenger luggage down from the cruise ship.

stations.name: Lei stand
stations.desc: Strings a batch of flower leis for arriving passengers.

stations.name: Gift shop
stations.desc: Packs a batch of souvenir gift bags.

insp.sub: Keep spoiled loads off the quay

districts.name: Old Harbor
districts.twist: Your first berth. Steady ships, steady trucks.

districts.name: River Docks
districts.twist: Barges come down the river in convoys. Patient drivers, small fees, big rushes.

districts.name: Industrial Bay
districts.twist: Factories open early. A huge morning rush of impatient drivers who pay well.

districts.name: Palm Cove
districts.twist: Hot days, fruit boats and seagulls that peck at your fish. Tap them away.

districts.name: Lighthouse Quay
districts.twist: Old-school shippers who talk. Reputation swings twice as hard here.

districts.name: Free Trade Zone
districts.twist: Huge volume and premium fees. Convoys of trucks arrive all at once and want it now.

districts.name: Frost Harbor
districts.twist: Fuel sells double. Pack ice closes the harbor, then the backlog hits all at once.

districts.name: Canal Locks
districts.twist: When the lock opens, every berth gets a fresh ship at once.

districts.name: Night Port
districts.twist: The rush comes after dark with big multi-load orders.

districts.name: Megaport
districts.twist: Fog banks roll in and out: dead calm, then every truck at once. Inspectors come often.

rack.name: Tag board
rack.desc: Holds your tags and papers. Tap one to add it to a load in the yard.

barista.name: Crane operator
barista.desc: Starts the cranes and pipelines and moves landed cargo into the yard.

server.name: Yard driver
server.desc: Drives loads from the yard onto waiting trucks.

manager.name: Harbor master
manager.desc: Runs the terminal while you work elsewhere. With no harbor master, it earns nothing while you are away.

finisher.name: Customs broker
finisher.desc: Adds clearances and tags to loads in the yard.

host.name: Dispatcher
host.desc: Radios the gate so every driver waits 15% longer.

training.name: Crane academy
training.eff: Staff work 6% faster per level, at every terminal.

offline.name: Night shift
offline.eff: Earn more while the game is closed: +8% rate and +1 hour cap per level.

loyalty.name: Freight app
loyalty.eff: +6% trucks at every terminal per level.

grind.name: Crane R&D
grind.eff: Every crane and pipeline works 5% faster per level.

security.name: Harbor police
security.eff: Blocks 15% of rival attacks per level.

legal.name: Maritime lawyers
legal.eff: Your sabotage gets caught 12% less often per level.

autolab.name: Automation lab
autolab.eff: Terminals handle 10% more volume per level when you are away.

line.name: Shipping line
line.eff: Your own ships: every ship docks with 8% more cargo and stays 6% longer per level.

trucking.name: Trucking company
trucking.eff: Drivers wait 5% longer at every terminal per level.

cold.name: Cold storage
cold.eff: Fish wharves: costs -6% and fees +3%; reefers and fish stay fresh 8% longer per level.

rail.name: Rail freight
rail.eff: All handling costs -4% per level, and freight trains pay 5% more per level.

adagency.name: Trade magazine
adagency.eff: Marketing 10% cheaper and 10% stronger per level.

refinery.name: Refinery
refinery.eff: Bulk terminals: costs -6% and fees +3%; silos and conveyors 6% faster per level.

realty.name: Waterfront real estate
realty.eff: Berth rent -10% and new terminals 5% cheaper per level.

resort.name: Island resort
resort.eff: Cruise terminals: costs -6% and fees +3%; luggage and gift shops 6% faster per level.

social.name: Shipping-line promo
social.desc: +40% trucks for 5 minutes and some fame.

event.name: Open-port day
event.desc: +80% trucks for 4 minutes and a reputation bump.

rumor.name: Leak delay rumors
rumor.desc: Knocks their strength down 15. 30% chance you get caught.

poach.name: Poach their best operator
poach.desc: Strength -25 and the operator joins you if there is room. 35% risk.

squeeze.name: Undercut their shipping line
squeeze.desc: Strength -40. Needs your own shipping line. 40% risk.

crash.name: Block their berth
crash.desc: Strength -60. 45% risk of a big scandal.

text.tutTake: Tap the load to move it to the yard
text.tutServe: Tap the load to put it on the truck

do.small: Every berth gets busy at once
The cranes slow down in the wind
